blocks.task_summary: Find the area of sector BOA with radius 19.5 cm and angle 210°.
method_path: Apply sector area formula: (1/2) × r² × θ = (1/2) × 19.5² × (7π/6)
accepted_alternatives: Use degree formula: area = (210/360) × π × 19.5² = 3549π/16

evidence.basis: EITHER 210° = 210π/180 = 7π/6 radians (A1); attempt to use radian formula for area of sector (M1); area = (1/2)(19.5²)(7π/6) OR attempt to use degree formula for area of sector (M1); area = (210/360)π(19.5²) (A1); THEN area = 3549π/16 = 696.844... ≈ 697 cm² A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the radius of the cone formed by joining the radii of the sector.
method_path: Calculate arc length of sector: arc = rθ = 19.5 × (7π/6) = 91π/4 ≈ 71.4712 cm
Set arc length equal to circumference of cone base: 2πr_cone = 71.4712
accepted_alternatives: Use area from part (a): set π × r_cone × 19.5 = area, solve for r_cone

evidence.basis: EITHER arc length = 19.5 × (7π/6) OR (210/360) × 2π × 19.5 = 91π/4 = 71.4712... (A1); attempt to set 2πr equal to arc length (M1); 2πr = 71.4712... OR attempt to set πrl equal to their area from (a) (M1); 19.5πr = 696.844... (A1); THEN r = 91/8 = 11.375 ≈ 11.4 cm A1

method_path: Identify coefficient of x in tan(2x) as 2.
Apply period formula for tangent: period = π / |coefficient|.

blocks.task_summary: Find a and b given graph passes through (π/12, 5) and (π/3, 7).
method_path: Substitute x = π/12, f(x) = 5 into f(x) = a tan(2x) + b to get a tan(π/6) + b = 5.
Substitute x = π/3, f(x) = 7 into f(x) = a tan(2x) + b to get a tan(2π/3) + b = 7.
Solve system to find a = -√3/2, b = 11/2.
accepted_alternatives: Work with x values converted to degrees.

evidence.basis: attempt to substitute ... to obtain two equations (M1)
a tan(π/6) + b = 5 and a tan(2π/3) + b = 7 ⇒ a/√3 + b = 5 and -a√3 + b = 7

Add initial population to change to get final population
accepted_alternatives: Use indefinite integral to find general solution P(t) = -7172413.7... e^{-0.0145t} + c, determine c using initial condition, then evaluate at t=4.

(A1); attempt to add initial population to their change (M1); population = 6.78×10^6 - 404165.8... = 6375834.1... ≈ 6.38×10^6 (A1). METHOD 2: indefinite integral approach with same final answer.

blocks.task_summary: Find the gradient of the tangent T_k to the curve y = h(x) at the point (k, h(k)) in terms of k, where h(x) = 15 cos(πx/50).
method_path: Apply chain rule: derivative of 15 cos(πx/50) is -15 * (π/50) * sin(πx/50)
Evaluate at x = k to get gradient: h'(k) = -(15π/50) sin(πk/50) = -(3π/10) sin(πk/50)
accepted_alternatives: h'(k) = -15 sin(πk/50) * (π/50) (unsimplified)

evidence.basis: recognition of the need to differentiate (M1); h'(x) = -15 sin(πx/50) * (π/50) = -(15π/50) sin(πx/50) = -(3π/10) sin(πx/50) A1A1; Note: Award A1 for -15 sin(πk/50) and A1 for factor of π/50.

Accept k = 7.24211... and k = 42.7578... (exact from GDC)

blocks.task_summary: Given sec a = 1.5, 0 < a < π, find f(a).

accepted_alternatives: Use arcsec(1.5) to find a ≈ 0.841, then evaluate f(a) directly.
